messages:
Jess: FYI I saw duplicate deliveries from the sample webhook during a load run. SDK retried identical POSTs after 429s.

Omar: which SDK and retry config? that usually means non-idempotent requests were retried without an Idempotency-Key.

Jess: sdk-go v0.17. Default retry settings in sample app. No idempotency header.

retry-bot: infra: rate-limit tuning applied to eu-west on 2026-03-20T09:00Z (burst reduced).

Ria: quick plan: 1) SDK should honor Retry-After header if present. 2) change default jitter to decorrelated or full jitter (avoid tiny fixed jitter). 3) do not auto-retry state-changing endpoints unless an Idempotency-Key present or unsafe_replay explicitly enabled.

Omar: agree. also add a max total retry duration (e.g., 25s) and surface a distinct error like "RetriesExhausted" with attempt count in metadata.

Jess: for the sample app we can add an opt-in toggle to attach Idempotency-Key: uuid4() for create flows and show a big yellow warning when disabled.

Ria: i'll update docs and a small retry-policy JSON snippet. Omar, can you take the SDK change + an integration test that simulates 429 + Retry-After and asserts single delivery when idempotency is used?

Omar: taking it. will feature-flag the behavior for one release and include metrics: retry_attempts, gave_up_count, avg_backoff. PR coming.

Jess: thanks, landing this will stop noisy duplicates in our demos :thumbsup:

retry-bot: pr-tracker: omar/sdk-retry-update opened PR #4382 (CI queued).
